passages.text: The wicked flee when no one pursues, but the righteous are as bold as a lion.
passages.sermon:
The wicked run away.
No one chases them.
The righteous stand firm.
The righteous are bold like a lion.
passages.original: נָ֣סוּ וְאֵין־ רֹדֵ֣ף רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝צַדִּיקִ֗ים כִּכְפִ֥יר יִבְטָֽח׃

passages.text: A land in rebellion has many rulers, but a man of understanding and knowledge maintains order.
passages.sermon:
A land that rebels has many rulers.
Rebellion causes instability.
Many people try to take control.
A man who understands and knows what is right brings order.
He helps the land last long in peace.
passages.original: בְּפֶ֣שַֽׁע אֶ֭רֶץ רַבִּ֣ים שָׂרֶ֑יהָ וּבְאָדָ֥ם מֵבִ֥ין יֹ֝דֵ֗עַ כֵּ֣ן יַאֲרִֽיךְ׃

passages.text: A destitute leader who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain that leaves no food.
passages.sermon:
A destitute leader oppresses the poor.
He acts with cruelty and injustice.
He is like a strong rain that sweeps everything away.
This rain destroys crops and food.
It leaves people with nothing to eat.
passages.original: גֶּ֣בֶר רָ֭שׁ וְעֹשֵׁ֣ק דַּלִּ֑ים מָטָ֥ר סֹ֝חֵ֗ף וְאֵ֣ין לָֽחֶם׃

passages.text: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked, but those who keep the law resist them.
passages.sermon:
People who abandon God's law praise wicked people.
They support those who do evil.
People who obey God's law stand against the wicked.
They oppose those who do wrong.
passages.original: עֹזְבֵ֣י ת֭וֹרָה יְהַֽלְל֣וּ רָשָׁ֑ע וְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י ת֝וֹרָ֗ה יִתְגָּ֥רוּ בָֽם׃פ

passages.text: Evil men do not understand justice, but those who seek the LORD comprehend fully.
passages.sermon:
Evil men do not understand justice.
They do not know what is right.
Those who seek the LORD understand everything.
They know what is just and true.
passages.original: אַנְשֵׁי־ רָ֭ע לֹא־ יָבִ֣ינוּ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּמְבַקְשֵׁ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה יָבִ֥ינוּ כֹֽל׃

passages.text: Better a poor man who walks with integrity than a rich man whose ways are perverse.
passages.sermon:
A poor man can walk with integrity.
He acts honestly.
He lives uprightly.
A rich man can have perverse ways.
He acts dishonestly.
He lives crookedly.
It is better to be poor and have integrity than to be rich and have perverse ways.
passages.original: טֽוֹב־ רָ֭שׁ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בְּתֻמּ֑וֹ מֵעִקֵּ֥שׁ דְּ֝רָכַ֗יִם וְה֣וּא עָשִֽׁיר׃

passages.text: A discerning son keeps the law, but a companion of gluttons disgraces his father.
passages.sermon:
A discerning son keeps the law.
A discerning son understands what is right.
A companion of gluttons brings shame to his father.
A companion of gluttons does not honor his family.
passages.original: נוֹצֵ֣ר תּ֭וֹרָה בֵּ֣ן מֵבִ֑ין וְרֹעֶה זֽ֝וֹלְלִ֗ים יַכְלִ֥ים אָבִֽיו׃

passages.text: He who increases his wealth by interest and usury lays it up for one who is kind to the poor.
passages.sermon: A person may gain more money by charging interest and usury.\r\nThis person stores up wealth.\r\nLater, someone who is kind to the poor will receive that wealth.
passages.original: מַרְבֶּ֣ה ה֭וֹנוֹ בְּנֶ֣שֶׁךְ וּבְתַרְבִּית לְחוֹנֵ֖ן דַּלִּ֣ים יִקְבְּצֶֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: Whoever turns his ear away from hearing the law, even his prayer is detestable.
passages.sermon:
A person can choose to ignore God's law.
This person refuses to listen to God's commands.
God rejects this person's prayer.
God sees this prayer as detestable.
passages.original: מֵסִ֣יר אָ֭זְנוֹ מִשְּׁמֹ֣עַ תּוֹרָ֑ה גַּֽם־ תְּ֝פִלָּת֗וֹ תּוֹעֵבָֽה׃

passages.text: He who leads the upright along the path of evil will fall into his own pit, but the blameless will inherit what is good.
passages.sermon:
A person may lead upright people onto an evil path.
This person causes others to do wrong.
This person will fall into his own pit.
He will suffer because of his own actions.
Blameless people act with integrity.
Blameless people will receive what is good.
They will inherit blessings.
passages.original: מַשְׁגֶּ֤ה יְשָׁרִ֨ים׀ בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ רָ֗ע בִּשְׁחוּת֥וֹ הֽוּא־ יִפּ֑וֹל וּ֝תְמִימִ֗ים יִנְחֲלוּ־ טֽוֹב׃

passages.text: A rich man is wise in his own eyes, but a poor man with discernment sees through him.
passages.sermon:
A rich man thinks he is wise.
He trusts his own judgment.
A poor man has discernment.
The poor man understands the truth.
The poor man sees through the rich man.
passages.original: חָכָ֣ם בְּ֭עֵינָיו אִ֣ישׁ עָשִׁ֑יר וְדַ֖ל מֵבִ֣ין יַחְקְרֶֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory, but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.
passages.sermon:
Righteous people win.
Great glory appears.
Wicked people rise up.
People hide themselves.
passages.original: בַּעֲלֹ֣ץ צַ֭דִּיקִים רַבָּ֣ה תִפְאָ֑רֶת וּבְק֥וּם רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְחֻפַּ֥שׂ אָדָֽם׃

passages.text: He who conceals his sins will not prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them will find mercy.
passages.sermon: A person who hides his sins will not succeed.\r\nA person who admits his sins will find mercy.\r\nA person who leaves his sins behind will find mercy.
passages.original: מְכַסֶּ֣ה פְ֭שָׁעָיו לֹ֣א יַצְלִ֑יחַ וּמוֹדֶ֖ה וְעֹזֵ֣ב יְרֻחָֽם׃

passages.text: Blessed is the man who is always reverent, but he who hardens his heart falls into trouble.
passages.sermon:
A man who is always reverent is blessed.
A reverent man fears God at all times.
A man who hardens his heart will fall into trouble.
A hard-hearted man refuses to listen or change.
Trouble comes to those who do not fear God.
passages.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י אָ֭דָם מְפַחֵ֣ד תָּמִ֑יד וּמַקְשֶׁ֥ה לִ֝בּ֗וֹ יִפּ֥וֹל בְּרָעָֽה׃

passages.text: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
passages.sermon:
A wicked ruler controls helpless people.
A wicked ruler acts with power and violence.
A wicked ruler is like a roaring lion.
A wicked ruler is like a charging bear.
Helpless people cannot defend themselves.
A wicked ruler brings fear and danger to helpless people.
passages.original: אֲרִי־ נֹ֭הֵם וְדֹ֣ב שׁוֹקֵ֑ק מֹשֵׁ֥ל רָ֝שָׁ֗ע עַ֣ל עַם־ דָּֽל׃

passages.text: A leader who lacks judgment is also a great oppressor, but he who hates dishonest profit will prolong his days.
passages.sermon:
A leader who lacks judgment becomes a great oppressor.
He causes much suffering.
A person who hates dishonest profit will live a long life.
He will prolong his days.
passages.original: נָגִ֗יד חֲסַ֣ר תְּ֭בוּנוֹת וְרַ֥ב מַעֲשַׁקּ֑וֹת שֹׂנְאֵי בֶ֝֗צַע יַאֲרִ֥יךְ יָמִֽים׃פ

passages.text: A man burdened by bloodguilt will flee into the Pit; let no one support him.
passages.sermon: A man carries guilt for shedding another’s blood.\r\nThis man will run away until he reaches the grave.\r\nNo one should help him.
passages.original: אָ֭דָם עָשֻׁ֣ק בְּדַם־ נָפֶשׁ עַד־ בּ֥וֹר יָ֝נ֗וּס אַל־ יִתְמְכוּ־ בֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He who walks with integrity will be kept safe, but whoever is perverse in his ways will suddenly fall.
passages.sermon: A person who lives with integrity will be safe.\r\nA person who acts in a crooked way will fall suddenly.
passages.original: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ תָּ֭מִים יִוָּשֵׁ֑עַ וְנֶעְקַ֥שׁ דְּ֝רָכַ֗יִם יִפּ֥וֹל בְּאֶחָֽת׃

passages.text: The one who works his land will have plenty of food, but whoever chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.
passages.sermon:
A person who works his own land will have plenty of food.
He will not go hungry.
A person who chases empty dreams will have nothing.
He will become poor.
passages.original: עֹבֵ֣ד אַ֭דְמָתוֹ יִֽשְׂבַּֽע־ לָ֑חֶם וּמְרַדֵּ֥ף רֵ֝קִ֗ים יִֽשְׂבַּֽע־ רִֽישׁ׃

passages.text: A faithful man will abound with blessings, but one eager to be rich will not go unpunished.
passages.sermon:
A faithful man receives many blessings.
A faithful man shows trustworthiness and reliability.
A man who is eager to become rich will not escape punishment.
A man who rushes to gain wealth will face consequences.
passages.original: אִ֣ישׁ אֱ֭מוּנוֹת רַב־ בְּרָכ֑וֹת וְאָ֥ץ לְ֝הַעֲשִׁ֗יר לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה׃

passages.text: To show partiality is not good, yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.
passages.sermon:
Partiality means favoring one person over another unfairly.
Showing partiality is not good.
A man may do wrong for a piece of bread.
He may act unjustly even for a small gain.
passages.original: הַֽכֵּר־ פָּנִ֥ים לֹא־ ט֑וֹב וְעַל־ פַּת־ לֶ֝֗חֶם יִפְשַׁע־ גָּֽבֶר׃

passages.text: A stingy man hastens after wealth and does not know that poverty awaits him.
passages.sermon:
A stingy man wants to get rich quickly.
He rushes after wealth.
He does not know what will happen to him.
Poverty will come to him.
passages.original: נִֽבֳהָ֥ל לַה֗וֹן אִ֭ישׁ רַ֣ע עָ֑יִן וְלֹֽא־ יֵ֝דַע כִּי־ חֶ֥סֶר יְבֹאֶֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: He who rebukes a man will later find more favor than one who flatters with his tongue.
passages.sermon:
A person who rebukes another person acts honestly.
This person corrects others directly.
Later, people will show more favor to this honest person.
A person who flatters with his tongue speaks insincerely.
People will show less favor to the flatterer than to the honest person.
passages.original: מ֘וֹכִ֤יחַ אָדָ֣ם אַ֭חֲרַי חֵ֣ן יִמְצָ֑א מִֽמַּחֲלִ֥יק לָשֽׁוֹן׃

passages.text: He who robs his father or mother, saying, “It is not wrong,” is a companion to the man who destroys.
passages.sermon:
A person robs his father or his mother.
This person says, “It is not wrong.”
This person becomes a companion to a man who destroys.
A man who destroys causes harm.
A person who excuses robbing parents joins with those who do evil.
passages.original: גּוֹזֵ֤ל׀ אָ֘בִ֤יו וְאִמּ֗וֹ וְאֹמֵ֥ר אֵֽין־ פָּ֑שַׁע חָבֵ֥ר ה֝֗וּא לְאִ֣ישׁ מַשְׁחִֽית׃

passages.text: A greedy man stirs up strife, but he who trusts in the LORD will prosper.
passages.sermon:
A greedy man causes conflict.
He wants more for himself.
He does not care about others.
He brings trouble wherever he goes.
A person who trusts in the LORD will prosper.
He depends on God.
God will take care of him.
God will give him what he needs.
passages.original: רְחַב־ נֶ֭פֶשׁ יְגָרֶ֣ה מָד֑וֹן וּבוֹטֵ֖חַ עַל־ יְהוָ֣ה יְדֻשָּֽׁן׃

passages.text: He who trusts in himself is a fool, but one who walks in wisdom will be safe.
passages.sermon:
A person who trusts only in himself is a fool.
A fool relies on his own heart.
A wise person walks in wisdom.
A wise person will be safe.
passages.original: בּוֹטֵ֣חַ בְּ֭לִבּוֹ ה֣וּא כְסִ֑יל וְהוֹלֵ֥ךְ בְּ֝חָכְמָ֗ה ה֣וּא יִמָּלֵֽט׃

passages.text: Whoever gives to the poor will not be in need, but he who hides his eyes will receive many curses.
passages.sermon:
A person gives to the poor.
This person will not lack anything.
A person hides his eyes from the poor.
This person will receive many curses.
passages.original: נוֹתֵ֣ן לָ֭רָשׁ אֵ֣ין מַחְס֑וֹר וּמַעְלִ֥ים עֵ֝ינָ֗יו רַב־ מְאֵרֽוֹת׃

passages.text: When the wicked come to power, people hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous flourish.
passages.sermon:
Wicked people sometimes gain power.
When wicked people rule, ordinary people hide.
People hide because they fear the wicked rulers.
When wicked people die or lose power, they are gone.
After the wicked perish, righteous people increase.
Righteous people flourish when the wicked are gone.
passages.original: בְּק֣וּם רְ֭שָׁעִים יִסָּתֵ֣ר אָדָ֑ם וּ֝בְאָבְדָ֗ם יִרְבּ֥וּ צַדִּיקִֽים׃
